hypothesis: Contrastive Learning is used to train models under label noise by contrasting clean and noisy samples to improve generalization efficiently
description: This method identifies reliable representations by pulling together similar inputs with consistent labels while pushing apart those with conflicting ones, allowing the model to learn robust features without clean annotations; it reduces the need for manual labeling and speeds up training by leveraging large noisy datasets, making it suitable for real-world scenarios where annotations are expensive or unreliable
